about: revvisual 2026-11-20, the user: 'Revenge Wrestlers without titantrons seem to have The Rock's titantron. They should have none unless a video is in their folder.' The arcade's versus (tron_novideo_a's way): Kanyon (Revenge, no video in his folder; based on The Rock) enters first, Al Snow (WrestleMania 2000, video.bin in his folder) second, at RAW IS WAR with the Titantron screens on. state.csv's rr_put_out / rr_kept_out: tron_qa (tron.c) -- the video picked, the screen's mode, his music, the entrant. Look at every shot of Kanyon's entrance: no video on the screen, the arena's own picture; Al Snow's own video on his.

expect.name: Kanyon's music on with no video: nothing picked, the screen's own picture
expect.check: screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF10) == 0x010 and rr_put_out == 0 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF) == 0

expect.name: never a video picked or shown while Kanyon (entrant 0) enters
expect.check: not (screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF10) == 0x010 and (rr_put_out != 0 or (rr_kept_out & 0xF) == 2))

expect.name: Al Snow's own video on the screen
expect.check: screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF1F) == 0x112
